description: A slim padded envelope, flat enough to slide up a sleeve or into a waistband, the flap glued and heat-sealed along a seam scored so you can feel exactly where to tear it. Whatever's inside is thin, dense, and very much not legal. The fence didn't say what — only that it lands on you, not them.
name: a padded envelope
